BERTE'

RELAX COLLECTION

BERTE'

Characterized by sartorial elegance, a model rich in refined details such as the crisscross stitching on the headrest and armrest and the double side stitching that emphasizes the perimeter. Bertè is available in fabric or leather versions with a metal foot and is transformable thanks to a dual-motor seat recliner and an electric vertical-type headrest that can also be manually adjusted forward.
